component.name: EmuSync
component.summary: Launch games and synchronize emulator saves with Google Drive

description.p: EmuSync is a desktop game launcher and save synchronization manager for emulators and native PC games. Organize your library, play offline, and synchronize progress between devices using your Google Drive account.
Resolve conflicting saves, recover local backups, and add games to Steam for access from Big Picture mode or Steam Deck.
